g.text: C392 · Listing 9.3 — building a ring modulator circuit in INTERCONNECT

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: Chapter 9 — Photonic circuit modelling · Sec. 9.7 Code listings (book p. 345) · described in Sec. 9.5

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64d2ff
font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Adds an Optical Network Analyzer centred at 193.1 THz, 10 THz wide, with two input ports.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64d2ff

g.text: Step 2 — the building blocks (see C385, Fig. 9.12b)

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Two N-port S-param blocks load the coupler’s .sparam file (passivity, reciprocity tested).

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: A straight waveguide, length πR (R = 15 µm), adds only loss: 300 dB/m (3 dB/cm).

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Propagation phase is not added there: the coupler S-parameters already include it.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: A phase modulator (caption: pn-junction phase-vs-voltage data), fed by a DC source set to 0.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64d2ff

g.text: Step 3 — wire it into a ring

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Coupler 1 → waveguide → coupler 2 → phase modulator → back to coupler 1: a closed loop.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: The analyzer feeds coupler 1, and listens at its through port and at coupler 2 (drop port).

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64d2ff

g.text: Step 4 — run and read the results (see C386, Fig. 9.13)

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Plots through and drop spectra (dB) and through-port phase; also reads each resonance’s Q.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: Compact model = a small, fast stand-in for a device, built from its simulated data.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #30d158

g.text: Takeaway: ring modulator = two coupler S-parameter blocks + a lossy waveguide + a phase shifter, in a loop.
